description: Send a book, children's book, comic, magazine, puzzle book or template (by its catalogue id) to the reader's e-reader. Only free, openly licensed items exist; nothing is purchased.

device.description: Optional: remarkable, kindle, or cloud:dropbox / cloud:gdrive / cloud:onedrive. Defaults to the reader's main device.

name: send_to_my_device
title: Send to my e-reader
